paragraph: A rare white lobster has arrived at the University of New England. This ghost lobster is so uncommon that the odds of finding one are 1 in 100 million. It was donated by the Maine State Aquarium to help scientists study its genetics. The crustacean is settling into its new home at the school's Marine Science Center. It arrived just in time for Halloween. We are glad it has a place to study.
